task: Use robots.txt as optional audit evidence and sitemap discovery without blocking retrieval.
nonGoals: Frontend changes, weakening destination safety, paid services, deployment or merge

outcomes.description: Product and supporting retrieval proceed independently of robots rules, fetch failures and parse errors.
outcomes.evidence: Blocked, malformed, redirected, oversized and stalled robots regressions

outcomes.description: Verified policies still inform crawler scores and sitemap discovery while unknown policy stays unmeasured.

process.description: Separate plan, independent review and hosted CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse bounded fetch and inspection logic without dependencies.

exitTest.reason: Changing crawl policy does not alter workflow or continuation.
